557	// maybeCreateVersion creates a version snapshot if versioning criteria are met.
558	func (s *Server) maybeCreateVersion(ctx context.Context, pageID, userID int64, newContent string, manualSave bool, agentName *string) error {
559		hash := fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(newContent)))
560	
561		// Fetch last version
562		lastVersion, err := s.db.Client.WikiPageVersion.Query().
563			Where(wikipageversion.WikiPageID(pageID)).
564			Order(ent.Desc(wikipageversion.FieldVersionNumber)).
565			First(ctx)
566		if err != nil && !ent.IsNotFound(err) {
567			return err
568		}
569	
570		// Skip if content identical to last version
571		if lastVersion != nil && lastVersion.ContentHash == hash {
572			return nil
573		}
574	
575		shouldVersion := manualSave
576		if !shouldVersion {
577			if lastVersion == nil {
578				// First content — version it
579				if newContent != "" {
580					shouldVersion = true
581				}
582			} else if time.Since(lastVersion.CreatedAt) > 15*time.Minute {
583				// Time-based snapshot
584				shouldVersion = true
585			} else if isSignificantChange(lastVersion.Content, newContent) {
586				// Large diff
587				shouldVersion = true
588			}
589		}
590	
591		if !shouldVersion {
592			return nil
593		}
594	
595		versionNum := 1
596		if lastVersion != nil {
597			versionNum = lastVersion.VersionNumber + 1
598		}
599	
600		ver, err := s.db.Client.WikiPageVersion.Create().
601			SetWikiPageID(pageID).
602			SetVersionNumber(versionNum).
603			SetContent(newContent).
604			SetContentHash(hash).
605			SetCreatedBy(userID).
606			Save(ctx)
607		if err != nil {
608			return err
609		}
610	
611		// Set agent_name via raw SQL (Ent schema doesn't have this field yet)
612		if agentName != nil {
613			if _, execErr := s.db.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE wiki_page_versions SET agent_name = $1 WHERE id = $2`, *agentName, ver.ID); execErr != nil {
614				s.logger.Warn("Failed to set agent_name on wiki version", zap.Error(execErr), zap.Int64("version_id", ver.ID))
615			}
616		}
617		return nil
618	}

620	// isSignificantChange returns true when the diff is >15% of old or >500 chars changed.
621	func isSignificantChange(oldContent, newContent string) bool {
622		oldLines := strings.Split(oldContent, "\n")
623		newLines := strings.Split(newContent, "\n")
624	
625		oldSet := make(map[string]int, len(oldLines))
626		for _, l := range oldLines {
627			oldSet[l]++
628		}
629	
630		charsChanged := 0
631		for _, l := range newLines {
632			if oldSet[l] > 0 {
633				oldSet[l]--
634			} else {
635				charsChanged += len(l)
636			}
637		}
638		// Also count lines removed from old
639		for l, cnt := range oldSet {
640			charsChanged += len(l) * cnt
641		}
642	
643		if charsChanged > 500 {
644			return true
645		}
646		if len(oldContent) > 0 && float64(charsChanged) > 0.15*float64(len(oldContent)) {
647			return true
648		}
649		return false
650	}
